title: All roads lead to Rome: Path-following Augmented Lagrangian Methods via Bregman Proximal Regularization
summary: We study Bregman proximal augmented Lagrangian methods with second-order oracles for convex convex-composite optimization problems. The outer loop is an instance of the Bregman proximal point algorithm with relative errors in the sense of Solodov and Svaiter, applied to the KKT operator associated with the problem.
